sources.title: Phases of a fermionic model with chiral condensates and Cooper pairs in 1+1 dimensions
sources.snippet: We study the phase structure of a 4-fermi model with three bare coupling constants, which potentially has three types of bound states. This model is a generalization of the model discussed previously by A. Chodos et al. [Phys. Rev. D 61, 045011 (2000)], which contained both chiral condensates and Cooper pairs.
